one_line: Pair each spoken benefit with a close shot of it happening, with the key word highlighted in the caption.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close-up from above: a hand holds a yellow fishing-rod toy over pink bath water and floating toys. Said (transcript) and subtitled word by word: "אם תשאלו אותי", "מה הופך משחק למשחק", "שאני באמת אוהבת".
q1_hook.why: A question about what makes a toy good is said and subtitled together from 0:00 (H1, H6, T3), over a colourful toy moving in water (E1, S1). The voice gives its answer by 0:04, so the gap closes fast (H5). No face is on screen (H4).

beats.what: A hand holds a fishing-rod toy over a pink bath; the question is subtitled
beats.why: A question and a toy in motion at once

beats.what: A child in the bath with a fountain disc; the Yookidoo boxes appear on a counter
beats.why: Answers the question and names the products

beats.what: Two small girls at a spout toy; "חקר, סקרנות, סיבה ותוצאה, למידה"
beats.why: Each named skill meets a visible action

beats.what: Children pour and move toys; a fountain disc; "מוטוריקה עדינה ותיאום עין-יד"
beats.why: A new skill and a new angle

beats.what: Top-down on the disc, the children from behind, the bath mat; "יחד בסבלנות"
Hands work a fishing rod and the spout; "בלי שהן מרגישות שהן לומדות"
beats.why: The thesis said once more over play

beats.what: "Yookidoo" over the toy, then the boxes on a wooden floor; where to find them
beats.why: Brand and where to buy at the close

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, save, share or tag ask in the video or the caption. A discount code in the caption's last line is an offer, not an engagement ask.
q2_flow.why: A new angle and a highlighted keyword every 2 to 6 s keep the middle moving (R3, E2), and the shared pattern (skill, then action) is easy to follow. The skill list is delivered inside bath-time warmth (K4). It ends right after the sign-off, with no tail (R1, E8).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and on screen 0:30 to 0:33: "Yookidoo", "תוכלו למצוא באתר", "וברשתות הנבחרות". Caption: sold at Palphot and stores; last line "יש לכן 🎁ממני 10% הנחה עם הקוד Roberta על כל האתר". No code in the video.
q3_cta.why: One buying action, said and shown after the value, and repeated in the caption (C6, C1). The discount code is only in the caption's last line, below "more", so the video gives no reason to act now (C6). The text sits in the lower band (T4).

q4_shown.what: A fishing-rod toy at 0:00; a child with a fountain disc at 0:03; Yookidoo boxes at 0:04 to 0:07; girls about 2 to 4 pouring and taking turns in the bath to 0:30; boxes on a wooden floor at 0:32. No price.
q4_shown.why: Real use in every shot, matched to what the mother says she sees, is first-hand (S6, R3, F8). The brand shows on boxes and text for about 6 of 34 s, so it stays light (H3, C7). Undressed young children in a bath are the footage S5 warns about.

q5_edit.what: About 25 shots in 34 s (first pass), about 1.4 s each, hard cuts landing on voice beats, within one bath scene. No speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 2 line chunks, keywords in cyan or yellow. Ends on boxes on a wooden floor.
q5_edit.why: Cuts a little faster than E2's 2 to 5 s, but all inside one scene, so the pace stays easy to follow (E2, R3). Subtitles follow the voice, so it works muted (E4, T1), though they cover part of the toys (T2).

q6_topic.what: What makes a toy good: a mother who is also a developmental guide names the skills bath toys train; it serves parents choosing toys for toddlers.
q6_topic.why: A real parent question (which toys to bring home) answered in a warm, modest tone (K6, K4). A skill list is reusable (R7). The mood is calm and approving, not the high-arousal peak K1 favours, and no occasion is named (K1, K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone, mostly high angles into a bathtub in even bathroom light: close-ups of toys and hands, two children seen from above and behind, a top-down view of a disc, boxes shot from above on a wooden floor at the end.
q7_filmed.why: Close, live shots of the toys in use fill the frame (F4, F8), and top-down views of the disc and boxes are clear (F5). A real home bath looks native (H8, F7), though some handheld shots shake or blur (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold white subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, centred about 73% down the frame, keywords in cyan or yellow: 0:01 "מה הופך משחק למשחק", 0:09 "אבל אני רואה פה חקר", 0:15 "מוטוריקה עדינה", 0:21 "יחד בסבלנות", 0:30 "Yookidoo", 0:31 "תוכלו למצוא באתר". No headline card or price.
q8_text.caption: "אחד הדברים שאני הכי אוהבת כאמא וכמלווה התפתחותית, הוא לראות איך ילדים לומדים תוך כדי משחק." About 89 words: a four-skill list with emoji, the brand name, where to buy, a discount line last. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Highlighted keywords make it work muted and easy to scan (T1, E4), but the subtitles sit low in the frame (T4, F2). The caption uses searchable words (bath toys, brand, skills) with no hashtags (T7). The Palphot collaboration is not disclosed in words (T8, S7).

weak_points: A generic benefit list; undressed young children in a bath on camera; subtitles in the lower band; the code only in the caption's last line; the palphot collaboration is not disclosed; no question or send ask.
lumebook_takeaway: Film hands turning pages of a LumeBook book, one close shot per spoken benefit, with the key word highlighted; end on the books laid on a table.
not_verified: Whether the children are the creator's; music (not established); the creator never shows a face, only hands. The transcript mishears "האמבט" and "יוקידו", so on-screen words are quoted from frames. Cut count from the first pass. No correction to src/coded.
